status: implemented for acceptance review; owner acceptance of individual corpus references remains separate
principle: Anatomical landmarks describe body joints consistently across images. They are not artwork bounds, painted seams, future pivots, or sockets.

shoulder.left.rule: Center of anatomical shoulder rotation where upper arm pivots against torso; inside contour, not outer skin edge.

shoulder.right.rule: Center of anatomical shoulder rotation where upper arm pivots against torso; inside contour, not outer skin edge.

elbow.left.rule: Center of elbow hinge between upper arm and forearm; not the most protruding elbow silhouette.

elbow.right.rule: Center of elbow hinge between upper arm and forearm; not the most protruding elbow silhouette.

wrist.left.rule: Center of wrist joint at narrow transition between forearm and hand; not palm, knuckles, fist tip, or fingertips.

wrist.right.rule: Center of wrist joint at narrow transition between forearm and hand; not palm, knuckles, fist tip, or fingertips.

hand.left.rule: Center of palm/metacarpal mass immediately distal to wrist; not fingertip or outside tip of fist.

hand.right.rule: Center of palm/metacarpal mass immediately distal to wrist; not fingertip or outside tip of fist.

occlusion: If a landmark is hidden or outside the image, record visibility state instead of inventing a coordinate.
poserBoundary: Artwork pivot and attachment socket are separate future records; they may reference an anatomical landmark without sharing its exact pixel location.
